motor-driver-l293d.name: ST L293D PDIP-16
motor-driver-l293d.dimensions_uncertainty: Body 19.8 x 6.35 mm is the TI L293D DIP-16 published body size; the ST PDIP-16 package drawing gives D = 20.0 mm max and e = 2.54 mm, e1 = 17.78 mm. Modelled with D = 19.8 mm, row spacing 7.62 mm, lead length 3.6 mm; pin-1 notch is at the catalogue top-view end.

servo.name: Tower Pro MG996R metal gear servo
servo.dimensions_uncertainty: Tower Pro states 40.7 x 19.7 x 42.9 mm approx; the 42.9 mm height is modelled as 36.5 mm case + flange and 12 mm output shaft, so the assembled height with horn exceeds the published figure. Draw-table values A 42.7, B 40.9, C 37, D 20, E 54, F 26.8 are used for the mounting ears.

servo.name: Tower Pro SG90 9 g servo
servo.dimensions_uncertainty: Tower Pro lists 23 x 12.2 x 29 mm overall; the modelled body is 22.8 x 12.2 mm with the 29 mm height split into 16 mm case + flange and 10 mm output shaft. Mounting ears and boss are from the published A/B/C/D/E/F drawing table (A 30.3, B 22.7, C 27, D 12.2, E 32.3, F 17).

arduino-nano.name: Arduino Nano (classic, v3)
arduino-nano.dimensions_uncertainty: Arduino publishes 43.16 x 17.76 mm board (docs.arduino.cc nano PCB guide) and 43.18 x 17.78 mm on the R4 datasheet page; the v3 outline is taken as 43.18 x 17.78 mm, tolerance +/-0.1 mm. Header positions are derived from the published 2.54 mm pitch, not measured.

stepper-motor.name: NEMA-17 42 mm hybrid stepper, 40 mm body
stepper-motor.dimensions_uncertainty: Novanta NEMA17 drawing gives 42.3 mm frame, body lengths 34/40/48 mm, 5 mm shaft, 22 mm pilot, 31 mm mounting pattern (4x M3). Rear boss height and cable exit diameter are not tabulated; modelled from the family drawing.

potentiometer.name: WH148-1A linear 10 kOhm panel potentiometer
potentiometer.dimensions_uncertainty: WH148 datasheet gives 16 mm class body, 7 mm shaft length, 6 mm shaft diameter, 300 deg rotation. Exact body height and lug geometry are not tabulated; modelled at 10.5 mm body height with two solder lugs at 90 deg, matching the published mechanical drawing layout.

lipo-2s-5200-50c.name: 2S 7.4 V 5200 mAh 50C hard-case LiPo
lipo-2s-5200-50c.manufacturer: NHX / Helios RC (same 138 x 47 x 25 mm 2S 5200 class)
lipo-2s-5200-50c.dimensions_uncertainty: Multiple 2S 5200 mAh hard-case packs publish 138 x 47 x 25 mm (NHX 2S5200-50EC3 and Helios RC 139.8 x 47.8 x 25.5). Modelled at 138 x 47 x 25 mm; cell chemistry pouch curvature is approximated.

quicrun-540-30t.name: Hobbywing QuicRun brushed 540-30T 1/10 motor
quicrun-540-30t.dimensions_uncertainty: Hobbywing publishes O.D. 36 mm, length 53.2 mm, shaft 3.175 mm, 168 g for the 540-30T. Mount tab geometry (21 mm pitch, M3) follows the standard 540 pattern used across RC brushed motors and is not a Hobbywing drawing value.

quicrun-wp-1060.name: Hobbywing QuicRun WP-1060 1/10 brushed ESC
quicrun-wp-1060.dimensions_uncertainty: Hobbywing manual dimension table: WP-1060-BRUSHED 36.5 x 32 x 18 mm, 39 g. Modelled at 35.5 x 32.18 mm using the retailer spec table; capacitor block height is not published and is modelled at 6 mm above the case.

rc-car-1to10-chassis.name: 1/10 scale custom RC chassis assembly (design dimensions, not a manufacturer product)
rc-car-1to10-chassis.dimensions_uncertainty: Every chassis dimension is a design decision recorded here, not a measurement of a real product. Tire and motor mounting positions are chosen to satisfy the sourced part envelopes; the spring rates, camber, ackermann and tire friction below are design targets with no measured source and must not be read as calibrated.

wheel-front-59mm.name: 1/10 scale 59 x 26 mm road tire on hex-12 rim
wheel-front-59mm.manufacturer: Custom concept (dimensioned from published 1/10 tire ranges)
wheel-front-59mm.dimensions_uncertainty: Matrix 1/10 Formula tires publish 59 mm diameter and 30 mm width; eXcelerate 1/10 fronts publish 62 x 29 mm; Hot Race 1/10 fronts publish 59 mm. Modelled at 59 x 26 mm to fit a 59 mm rolling diameter with a 12 mm hex hub as listed by 1/10 wheel sets. Compound and profile are design choices, not measured.

wheel-rear-68mm.name: 1/10 scale 68 x 26 mm drive tire on hex-12 rim
wheel-rear-68mm.manufacturer: Custom concept (dimensioned from published 1/10 tire ranges)
wheel-rear-68mm.dimensions_uncertainty: LightningRC 1/10 foam tires publish 68 mm diameter, 26 mm width, 12 mm hex. Those figures are used directly for the rear drive tire; tread pattern and carcass are design choices.
